Shipping.title: Fast, fully tracked delivery
Shipping.subtitle: Everything about how your order reaches you — and how returns and refunds work.
Shipping.intro: We're committed to precision hardware, excellent service and a smooth shopping experience. Please review our Shipping & Returns policy before placing an order.
Shipping.shippingLead: From our warehouse to your door — tracked every step of the way.
Shipping.processText: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation. We don't process, ship or deliver on weekends or public holidays. During busy periods processing may take a little longer — if there's a significant delay we'll email you.
Shipping.destText: We ship across the UK, Europe and to many international destinations. Customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes or import fees, and for ensuring the item may be imported into their country.
Shipping.methodsText: Choose your speed at checkout. Rates are calculated from your destination, package weight and the method you pick:
Shipping.trackText: Once your order ships you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking number (where available) so you can follow it right to your door.
Shipping.lostText: We work with reliable carriers, but we're not responsible for delays caused by carriers, weather, customs or other events beyond our control. If a package appears lost, contact us within 30 days of the estimated delivery date.
Shipping.damagedText: If your package arrives damaged, please keep all packaging and contact us within 48 hours of delivery. Photos of the package and contents may be needed to investigate and resolve it.
Shipping.returnsLead: Changed your mind? Here's the simple, no-stress process.
Shipping.windowText: You have 30 days from the delivery date to return an item. To be eligible it must be:
Shipping.windowList1: In the same condition you received it
Shipping.windowList2: Free from damage, alterations or markings
Shipping.windowList3: In its original packaging where applicable
Shipping.nonReturnText: The following generally can't be returned:
Shipping.nonReturn5: Items returned more than 30 days after delivery
Shipping.guaranteeText: Every machine is tested before it ships and backed by a 2-year warranty. If a unit arrives faulty or develops a covered fault, we'll repair or replace it — see the Warranty page for full details.
Shipping.s1: Email us with your order number and the reason for the return.
Shipping.s2: Wait for return authorization and instructions.
Shipping.s3: Ship the item back using a trackable shipping service.
Shipping.s4: We inspect it and confirm your refund.
Shipping.stepsNote: Returns sent without authorization may not be accepted.
Shipping.costText: You cover return shipping unless the wrong item was sent, it arrived damaged, or it's found to be faulty — in those cases we provide a prepaid label or reimburse reasonable costs.
Shipping.refundText: Once we receive and inspect your return we'll let you know whether it's approved. Approved refunds go to your original payment method within 5–10 business days (your bank may add time). Original shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is our error.
Shipping.exchangeText: Prefer a different model instead of a refund? Contact support and we'll help arrange an exchange where stock allows.
Shipping.incorrectText: Received the wrong item? Contact us within 7 days of delivery and we'll arrange a replacement or full refund at no extra cost.
Shipping.contactText: Our team is just a message away — reach us any time.

Warranty.subtitle: Every Prop Money machine is built to last and backed by a full warranty plus lifetime support.

Warranty.c1Text: Manufacturing defects, motor and sensor faults, and display or electronics failures.
Warranty.c2Text: Accidental damage, misuse, unauthorised repairs, and normal wear of consumable parts.
